title: Annual leave
text: Employees get 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year. Leave requests are submitted in the HR portal at least 7 days in advance.

title: Password reset
text: To reset your password, use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page. The reset link expires after 30 minutes. Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

title: VPN access
text: Connect to the corporate VPN with the SecureConnect client before using internal systems from outside the office, including from home or a cafe. The VPN session ends after 12 hours.

title: Expense claims
text: Submit expense claims within 30 days of the expense date with itemised receipts. Expense claims above 50,000 rupees need approval from a director. Approved expenses are reimbursed in the next payroll cycle.

title: Business travel
text: Book business travel through the travel desk. Economy class is standard for flights under 6 hours. Hotel stays are capped at 8,000 rupees per night in metro cities.

title: Laptops
text: IT issues a laptop on your first day. Report a lost or stolen laptop to the IT helpdesk within 24 hours. Laptops are replaced every 4 years.

title: Security incidents
text: Report a suspected phishing email with the Report Phish button in your mail client, or through the security portal, immediately. Do not forward suspicious emails to colleagues.

title: Data classification
text: Company data is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential or Restricted. Restricted data must not be shared outside the company and must not be stored on personal devices such as a personal phone.

title: Working from home
text: Employees may work from home up to 2 days per week with their manager's approval. Core collaboration hours are 11am to 4pm.

title: Public holidays
text: The company observes 12 public holidays per year. The holiday calendar for the next year is published in the HR portal every December.

title: Parental leave
text: Birth mothers receive 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Other parents receive 4 weeks of paid parental leave, taken within 6 months of the birth or adoption.

title: Gifts and conflicts of interest
text: Gifts from vendors worth more than 2,000 rupees must be declared in the compliance portal. Any conflict of interest must be disclosed to your manager.
